description: Water, the stuff of life, necessary for all kinds of crafting, cleaning, and avoiding an agonizing death by dehydration.  You should boil or purify it before using it as drinking water.
Water, the stuff of life.  This water looks like it has quite a bit of life in it in fact, and not the good kind.  You should filter and sterilize it if you want to drink it.
Fresh, clean water.  Truly the best thing to quench your thirst.
//: Clean water becomes regular water in about 4 weeks if exposed to air (1 week if outdoors).

description: This looks very much like water, and you think it would quench your thirst.  Now that it's been removed from the large, scarlet body of water, you see that it's in fact slightly yellow.  It smells like a forgotten swimming pool.
//: The Bromine will largely diffuse out over the course of a several days, and the acidity level shouldn't be dangerous.  Since nothing lives in it, it would be clean.  In real life this would happen rather quickly - a day or less.  Longer for fun and balance.
